articles.title: Bowie seizing Scotland shot after World Cup disappointment
articles.summary: BBC Scotland speaks to Kieron Bowie after he scores his first goal for his country against North Macedonia.

articles.title: Group has 'exploded' after Wales win - Bellamy
articles.summary: Craig Bellamy says Wales' win over Norway has "thrown a hand grenade" into their Nations League group as they go in search of another victory against Denmark in Cardiff on Sunday.

articles.title: Star man Connor left out of England squad for Rugby League World Cup
articles.summary: Leeds Rhinos' star man Jake Connor has been left out of England's 23-player squad for the upcoming Rugby League World Cup.
